parts.label: tapered aircraft fuselage
parts.appearance: long rounded spindle shaped body with a broad cylindrical front, tapered narrow tail and raised longitudinal ribs, aligned front to back at the center

parts.label: front engine cowling
parts.appearance: broad short cylindrical ring with a recessed radial center and thick rounded outer rim, mounted coaxially at the front end of the fuselage

parts.label: front two blade propeller
parts.appearance: two long tapered oval blades extending in opposite diagonal directions from a round central hub, forming one thin rotating assembly in front of the engine

parts.label: cockpit canopy
parts.appearance: small curved half dome with a thick curved perimeter rim, raised above the forward upper surface of the fuselage

parts.label: left inner wing
parts.appearance: short broad flat airfoil panel with rounded leading edge, extending horizontally from the left side of the fuselage to a straight outer hinge seam

parts.label: left folding outer wing
parts.appearance: long tapered airfoil panel with rounded outer tip and raised transverse ribs, extending laterally from a straight inner hinge seam on the left side

parts.label: left horizontal tailplane
parts.appearance: small thin tapered horizontal airfoil with a rounded outer end, attached laterally near the tail of the fuselage

parts.label: left landing strut
parts.appearance: short sturdy cylindrical telescoping strut sloping downward and outward, joining the underside of the front fuselage to the left wheel hub

parts.label: left landing wheel
parts.appearance: thick upright circular tire with a recessed round hub and narrow concentric side rings, mounted at the lower end of the left landing strut with its axle running left to right

parts.label: right inner wing
parts.appearance: short broad flat airfoil panel with rounded leading edge, extending horizontally from the right side of the fuselage to a straight outer hinge seam

parts.label: right folding outer wing
parts.appearance: long tapered airfoil panel with rounded outer tip and raised transverse ribs, extending laterally from a straight inner hinge seam on the right side

parts.label: right horizontal tailplane
parts.appearance: small thin tapered horizontal airfoil with a rounded outer end, attached laterally near the tail of the fuselage

parts.label: right landing strut
parts.appearance: short sturdy cylindrical telescoping strut sloping downward and outward, joining the underside of the front fuselage to the right wheel hub

parts.label: right landing wheel
parts.appearance: thick upright circular tire with a recessed round hub and narrow concentric side rings, mounted at the lower end of the right landing strut with its axle running left to right

parts.label: vertical tail rudder
parts.appearance: tall thin upright fin with rounded swept leading edge and straighter trailing edge, rising vertically from the rear center of the fuselage

object_description: Agent-designed ornate mechanical aircraft with separately hinged outer wings, propeller, rudder, tailplanes and landing wheels.
